🎓 Excited to share that I have successfully completed my Data Analyst internship at Apex Planet! 🚀

Over the past 2 Months, I worked on a complete end-to-end data analytics project that gave me hands-on experience with real-world data challenges.

📌 What I worked on:
✔️ Learned to clean and preprocess real-world messy datasets efficiently.
✔️ Built end-to-end data pipelines from raw data to actionable insights.
✔️ Developed interactive dashboards for stakeholder reporting.
✔️ Strengthened collaborative skills using Git version control.

🛠️ Skills I built:
Python (Pandas, NumPy) | Data Cleaning & EDA | Data Visualization (Matplotlib, Seaborn) | SQL & Database Querying | Dashboard Creation | Statistical Analysis | Git & GitHub

📁 I've consolidated everything into a master portfolio — including all 4 project repositories, a final presentation deck, and a detailed summary of learnings.

👉 Check out my portfolio here: https://github.com/rishu-kumarcse/RishuKumar-DataAnalyst-Internship-Portfolio

This internship has been a turning point in my data analytics journey. I'm grateful for the opportunity and excited to keep growing! 💪
